name: Mimph
description: Mimphs were small, semi-sentient creatures native to the Forest Moon of Endor. Although not fully sentient, mimphs were intelligent, and they were able to comprehend and use language to communicate with fully sentient beings like Ewoks. They were also able to manipulate tools and build villages, and teams of mimphs could even capture much larger prey.

data.name: Mimph
data.distinctions: Small stature; long ears and whiskers
